feature_spec: Run MediaPipe HandLandmarker (num_hands=2, detection/presence confidence 0.35) on an UNMIRRORED RGB camera frame (same orientation as the training photos).
For each hand take the 21 landmarks in pixel units: (x*W, y*H, z*W), where W,H are the width/height of the frame given to MediaPipe.
Ignore hands whose scale (below) is under 5 px. Sort hands by wrist x (left-most first). Keep at most 2.
scale = 0.5 * ( |p9 - p0|_xy + |p5 - p17|_xy ).  rel = (p - p0) / scale  (x, y, z all divided by the same scale).
Hand slot i (0 or 1) fills features[63*i : 63*i+63], landmark-major, each landmark as (x, y, z).
features[126 + i] = 1 if hand i is present, else 0.
features[128:130] = (wrist1 - wrist0)_xy / mean(scale0, scale1) when two hands are present, else 0.
Then standardise with isl_scaler.json, run the TFLite model, take the softmax output over isl_labels.json.
Suggested app logic: show a prediction only when confidence >= threshold (see the notebook's threshold table) and the same label holds for several consecutive frames.
pipeline: camera -> MediaPipe Hands -> 130 features -> StandardScaler -> TFLite
